body:
I run a Toronto service business and need a simple page for enquiries, plus content to send people there. Who can do both?

Give feedback

Yes. For what you described, I’d look for one Toronto provider that can build a simple enquiry/lead page and write the promotional content that sends people to it—rather than hiring a designer and copywriter separately.

A few good fits I found:

Mojo Media Web Design — Toronto-based, with custom conversion-focused websites plus conversion copywriting/content creation. Good if you want the page to look polished and the messaging handled together.

ThrillX Design - Web Design Company Toronto — Particularly focused on landing pages, conversion optimization and messaging/copywriting. Better fit if the page will be used for campaigns or paid traffic.

Creative Scope - Web Design & Digital Marketing Agency — Broader option combining web design with digital marketing, so they can potentially handle both the destination page and traffic-generation content.

The Story Web Design & Marketing — Toronto agency combining web design, messaging/copywriting and marketing/search strategy; worth considering if you want a more strategic partner.

Web Sharx — Full-service Toronto agency covering website design plus internet marketing, potentially useful if you want someone to handle the wider promotion as well.

For a small service business, I’d actually keep the project quite lean: one strong landing page + enquiry form + compelling copy + 3–5 pieces of promotional content (e.g. Google Business/Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn posts) that all point back to the page.

There are also some unusually straightforward Toronto options if price matters. The Website Team advertises small-business sites from $499 with custom copywriting included, while Marmalade Studio lists a $499 single-page enquiry site; Alliance Optima has a more conversion/marketing-oriented approach starting at $1,997.

If you tell me what kind of Toronto service business you run and roughly what you want to spend, I can narrow this to the 3 best matches and compare their likely fit/pricing.
